Schema: docs/en/design.md

## Type of change

- [ ] Add a new `card` — new `data/cards/<first_set>/<card_id>.json`
- [ ] Fix data in an existing `card` or `print`
- [ ] Add `print`s to the `data/prints/<set_code>/<lang>/` of an existing set
- [ ] Schema or documentation change

## What is changed?

<!-- card_id (or set_code + collector number + language), and a short summary -->

## Checklist

- [ ] File location and naming follow the schema (`docs/en/design.md`)
- [ ] Values match what is actually printed on the referenced `card`
- [ ] Strings are written as they appear on the card: spacing and line breaks included
- [ ] New `card_id` does not collide with an existing one
- [ ] Every referenced `card` / `set` exists in the repository
